title: Mudlark Gospel
description: A detuned mid-register saw bass-lead that preaches in the gutter: two jux/off-stacked voices grind against each other while a 32-cycle ladder filter sweep drags the tone from clogged murk to a snarling open growl. Crush, shape and a stepped FM index keep the character broken and corroded as the slow filter journey breathes underneath.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<f2 f2 ab2 [eb2 c2]>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .fm(sine.slow(19).range(1.5, 6)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5>/4")
    .penv("<0 -7 0 5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.06)
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 2600)).resonance(sine.slow(23).range(8, 17)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(11).range(1.5, 4)).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.18)
    .crush("<8 6 5 7>/8").shape(sine.slow(17).range(0.25, 0.55)).coarse("<1 1 2 1>/4")
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.07)
    .jux(rev)
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.5))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.3).pan(0.75))
    .pan(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .delay("0.3:0.375:0.55").room(0.2).gain(0.9)
)
